chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Al-ma'ruf is something apart from zakat, so draw near to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, through righteousness and maintaining kinship ties."
ai.seo_question: How can a person draw closer to Allah beyond paying zakat?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام teaches that acts of recognized goodness are broader than zakat alone. He urges believers to seek nearness to Allah عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ through general righteousness and by preserving ties of kinship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: “Kindness is something distinct from almsgiving; therefore, draw closer to Allah (swt), the Glorious and Exalted, through acts of goodness and maintaining family ties."
